primary_question: RGB anatomical pupil/iris waveform vs synchronized same-eye tracker pupil diameter under participant/device/lighting/glasses holdouts
nested_question: Do source-defined trial validity counts equal original pupil-validity or gaze-validity, and what is native-time reference coverage?
frontier: webcam pupillometry exists; prospective multi-device waveform holdouts unverified
scalar: participant-bootstrap 95% lower waveform Pearson r; nested 0-30 predicate match count and 0-15 same-eye 5s gate
confound: photometric pupil boundary bias, blur, gaze geometry, clock offsets; nested gaze-vs-pupil validity
falsification: source predicate mismatch invalidates pupil interpretation; frozen human RGB gates fail nuisance controls
publishable: untouched >=8 human paired participants, device/condition holdouts, independent checker, prior-art collision and unseen mechanism prediction
product: calibrated abstention with >=75% coverage; same-eye fixed reference
kill: 3 nondiscriminating primary runs; 2 blocked attempts per dataset path
science: metadata semantics unverified; original RGB waveform not tested
product_ledger: do not use gaze validity as pupil reference or demand binocular validity for same-eye task
wildcard: compare source gaze validity to pupil validity on gaze-invalid samples
smallest_claim: frozen executable reference preflight; not a physiological measurement result
